name: medici
description: A browser-based learning activity in which the student is a radiologic technologist. Twenty levels, one patient and one injury each, walking through the real X-ray workflow: read the order, position the patient, set kVp/mAs, collimate, take the exposure, read the film. One attempt per decision, no retries, and a debrief at the end of every case. Built for a client (a radiography educator) who owns the medical content and the art.

scripts.qa: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run e2e
